theorems.name: Submission.tangentMeasure_eventually_cone_small
theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Rn N)) (x : Rn N) (P : Submodule ℝ (Rn N)) (θ : ℝ), (∀ K : Set (Rn N), IsCompact K → μ K < ∞) → 0 < n → HasApproxTangentPlaneWithMultiplicity n μ x P θ → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∀ᶠ ρ in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), μ ({z | ‖P.starProjection (z - x)‖ ≤ ‖z - x‖ / 2} ∩ Metric.ball x ρ) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (ε * ρ ^ n)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
